title: Ember and Oath Anew
author: L. M. Okonkwo
blurb: Lior Hartwell, the youngest member of a dying guild, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
